properties.verseOrder: v1 v2 c1 b1 o1 o2 o3 o4 o5

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
You made a way for me
To enter the holy place

verse.name: b1a
verse.lines:
I am Yours, You are mine
And we’ll be together forever

verse.name: o1
verse.lines:
Out of every tribe and every tongue
And every people and nation
We’ve been redeemed, we’ve been redeemed
By the blood of the Lamb

verse.name: o2a
verse.lines:
Worthy is the Lamb
Worthy is the Lamb

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
You say, "Father I desire that they would be
That they would be with Me to see My glory"
You took all my shame and my iniquity
For the sake of freedom, You set me free

verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
By the crimson stain upon Your robe
With every nail with every pounding blow
By every stripe and every bruise upon Your back
I can hear You crying out

verse.name: o5
verse.lines:
I am washed by the blood of the Lamb
I am washed by the blood of the Lamb
By your scars,
My sins erased
I am innocent

verse.name: o3
verse.lines:
This was the joy set before You
That You would have our hearts forever

verse.name: o4
verse.lines:
All the other things I count as nothing
In the light of knowing you

verse.name: o2b
verse.lines:
Garments of praise
Fullness of joy
Unending mercy
New every morning

verse.name: b1b
verse.lines:
You should have all our hearts
We're the ones You've redeemed
You should have all our love
We're the ones You've made clean

verse.name: b1c
verse.lines:
I am Yours, You are mine
And Your blood it covers me

verse.name: b1d
verse.lines:
I am Yours, You are mine
And You've purchased me
I am Yours, You are mine
Your righteousness is mine
